title: Root build, lint and type-check config
summary:
Root hatch project manifest and pre-commit hooks that define the test, lint, format and mypy commands for the repository.

Agent mapper reason: These files only set up tooling and run commands, so they are grouped as a config unit separate from code and CI.

ownedFiles.reason: Defines hatch environments, dependencies, and ruff/mypy/pytest configuration used by every other slice.
Local hook set that runs lint and format checks before commit.

contextFiles.reason: CI invocation of the same test, lint and typecheck commands.
Second manifest that root tooling may need to account for.
